No more Republic.|Ramil and Dooku|}} The '''incident on Serenno''' was an invasion of the [[planet]] [[Serenno]] orchestrated by its [[Count of Serenno|Count]], [[Ramil]] of [[House Serenno]], in [[42 BBY]]. Ramil intended to turn the people of Serenno against the [[Galactic Republic]]. Ramil allowed [[pirate]]s to repeatedly raid Serenno, and its [[Great Houses]] called in [[Abyssin]] [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] to protect them due to Ramil's inaction. Ramil subsequently bought out the mercenaries, who took control of Serenno and its [[capital]] [[city]], [[Carannia]]. [[Lady]] [[Jenza]], sister of Ramil, led a resistance group of [[Serennian]] [[refugee]]s against the Abyssin, requesting help from her other brother, the [[Jedi Master]] [[Dooku]]. With Dooku's help, the refugees began to regain control of Serenno, but Ramil dispatched his [[Ramil's droid army|droid army]] to end the supposed insurrection: the assembled freedom fighters, Ramil intended, would be painted as insurrectionists he had put down. Dooku allowed the [[droid]]s to take him to face Ramil aboard the airship ''[[Windrunner]]'', where he [[Death|killed]] the [[Count]] and disabled his [[army]]. Following Ramil's death, the Abyssin retreated, and Dooku departed from the [[Jedi Order]], proclaiming himself as the new Count of Serenno on the belief that he needed to rebuild his homeworld. Further, a seam of [[sacanium]] had been discovered on Serenno, which finally attracted the Republic's attention. Annoyed that the government would only intercede once it could profit off Serenno, Dooku decided the planet would remain independent. {{Battle-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== According to author [[Cavan Scott]], the engagement is known as the "Battle of Serenno."{{Twitter|cavanscott|status/1585563290280902657|[[Cavan Scott]]|quote=Also, to find out a little bit more about his relationship with the Jedi post the Battle of Serrano, read PADAWAN from @DisneyBooks by the glorious @kierstenwhite}} ==Appearances== *''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]'' {{1st}} {{Flash}} *[[Dooku: Jedi Lost (script)|''Dooku: Jedi Lost'' script]] {{Flash}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' {{1stID|incident on Serenno}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |tr=Serenno İşgali }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Serenno, incident on}} [[Category:Battles of Serenno]] [[Category:Battles of the Republic Era]] [[Category:Invasions]]
